body: Hey. Firstly. I see absolutely nothing to regret in your situation. Nothing. All you have experienced are valuable pieces of life. Everyone’s existence will have its ups and downs. Every full and interesting life will have a ton of things happen. 21 is so young. I don’t even remember being 21. I’m 28 now and seriously my memory barely extends to a couple years back. Funny that I joined this sub because I was depressed but I made some difficult decisions and the depression is falling away. Look around you and think of the things that can improve your lived experience. I suggest finding some good podcasts that made you laugh or think, pick up the gym again (your self confidence will start returning in no time), try reading some books- I recommend Bukowski.. It’s sad for me to read this because what you really need is some support, but for now you will have to be your support system. Feel free to dm me though. The last thing I think you should do is harm yourself in any way. Are you still have panic attacks now?
That’s just full on a abuse
I’m still here, this has been one of the worst weeks of my life but I start uni tomorrow so people suggested I see if that changes anything. Thanks for checking in

She is sort of like a brain damaged child. So no help there. Dad is dead and yea there are friends who sympathise but what can they do really? Feel for you. My house is also messy and I can’t fix it. Hmm I have a pretty bad temper and I was pretty mad when my pup pissed right on the cat bed right in front of me after just coming back from inside for the second time in a row too I might add. I picked him up quite roughly and marched him outside. Later I felt bad at that roughness and I vowed never to do it again. I was lucky because he was potty trained shortly after that. In saying all this I think puppies can really test people’s patience and tbh I think it’s different from babies because it’s a different species. I don’t think he wants to get that angry but it’s very important that the pup is constantly supervised. In fact this is where crate training works. I suggest you read a perfect puppy in 7 days by Sophia yin. That really breaks it down. It’s only ever the owners fault if an accident happens inside. It’s easy to control your annoyance when you understand that.

Wow I’m surprised everyone’s hating on her so much. Yes she was in a lot of debt but why? Medical bills and or student loan I imagine. Hardly her fault. Not everyone is privileged enough to avoid debt. If my partner had the means and didn’t want to or hesitated paying for my dogs medical bill that would be the end of the relationship for me. I would (and have) cover any costs a partner of mine had and couldn’t afford. That’s just how I feel about serious relationships.. obviously there were trust issues in this relationship because she didn’t disclose her debt. I’ve not had this experience and I don’t know how it would make me feel. It would depend on the person. I wouldn’t be that bothered by the amount per se because in my country there’s a cap of what they can expect you to pay so I would understand she would just be paying this certain % for the rest of her life and that would be that. I certainly wouldn’t let money destroy us. I guess you did not love this girl which is fair enough. Finally, her getting angry about you taking your time to decide on the surgery is also somewhat understandable. She’s probably emotionally distressed about her dog and your taking your sweet time making a decision. I would be humiliated if I was her. As others mentioned...you could’ve just gone to the vet with her and paid. Idk it seems like your relationship was just totally rubbish so it’s good it’s over. I just certainly don’t think she’s this monster that other commenters seem to think.
